title: AkrBores
description: A plugin that will allow you to create drilling rigs for resource extraction!
body:
![Plugin Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/182fec8c136d6ab88d887e285eb40e26c018db5d.png)
- Interchangeable drill block
- Full editing of drilling layout
- Variable drilling speed
- Changing particles around the bore
- Custom heads support
- Customizable progress holograms
- Variable height of progress holograms
- Gradient support
- Variable size of drill storage (9, 18... and more slots)
- Support for changing the maximum height to which the drill can dig
- Supports full adjustment of the drill radius (x, y and z)
- Ability to change the sound of breaking blocks
- The drill can break blocks such as: Bedrock, Barrier, Command Block. (This option can be turned on and off)
- Protecting the resources of the drill storage from other players
- Server-level storage resource preservation (Restarting the server won't let you lose resources!)
- Ability to remotely control the drill (Administration tool)
- Support for restarting the plugin without stopping the server
- Full customization of the drill menu is possible
- Multi-language support (en, ua, pl)
- Full message customization
- Ability to disable and enable individual plugin messages
- Smart Help (Shows help for commands the player has permission to use)
- Tab-Complete support
- Checking for blocks under the player when installing a drill
- Checking if the player is not in a foreign region WorldGuard
- Checking if there is free space in the drill storage (When the storage is full, the drill stops)
- The drill will not disappear until the player takes all the resources from its storage.
- Ability to cancel the operation of the drill depending on your wishes
- Java 16+ support (The plugin does not work on Java versions 11 and older!)
- Protection of the bor from explosions (Blocks, mobs and niche types of explosions)

**With 100 downloads, the features can become even more! We need your support!**

![Plugin Commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/13307727c2de8d19c60af75f9dbd8b579bbbe389_0.webp)
- /abores give <BoreId> <PlayerName> <Count> - Giving a drill to a player
- /abores cancel all - Cancel all drills
- /abores cancel <BoreId> - Cancels the drill with the ID you specified
- /abores list - List of active drills
- /abores set <BoreId> - Sets the drill without issuing the drill as an object
- /abores reload - Reload the plugin
- /abores help - Shows a plugin commands list

![Plugin Permissions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/51d01445c1b2f91e6b6fdff6ae1d7efa40926893.png)
- akrbores.help - Permission to use the help command
- akrbores.give - Permission to use the command to give a drilling rig to a player
- akrbores.cancel - Permission to use command to cancel drill rigs
- akrbores.set - Permission to use the /abores set command
- akrbores.reload - Permission to use the plugin reload command
- akrbores.list - Permission to use the command to display a list of active drills

![Plugin Videos](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/46f26a3d629a81800b6afc6999fbec1ecc7713d8_0.webp)
